en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID`: set it to `1` on a self-hosted runner to have `claude -p` run inside a session use that session's ID and transcript, as in earlier versions
zh: 新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID`：在自托管运行器上将其设为 `1`，可使在 session 内运行的 `claude -p` 使用该 session 的 ID 和记录，与早期版本一致
